subject: Admin telemetry auditability and export SLA alignment
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenbridgehealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: audit-team@greenbridgehealth.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Audit evidence: admin telemetry + export options (SOC 2 scope)

Hi Sofia,

Thanks for the demo yesterday. As we prepare for our SOC 2 scoping call next week, the auditors asked for a short write-up on what admin activity we can expect to receive from Redwood if we request evidence. Specifically they want to know:

- Which admin actions are captured (user role changes, API key activity, console sign-ins, dedicated-node reconfig events)
- How long those events are retained and what retention tiers exist
- Export formats you can provide (CSV/JSON/Parquet) and whether exports include an immutable manifest/hmac
- Any PII redaction options and multi-tenant tenant-scoped slices

Would you be able to share a concise matrix and an example export manifest? If possible, we need a draft by Thursday 6/12 for our audit tracker.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Security & Privacy Lead
GreenBridge Health

--
Attachment: request-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet - referenced)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit evidence: admin telemetry + export options (SOC 2 scope)

Hi Elena — thanks for outlining the auditor questions, that helps a lot. Looping in Marissa (Security & Compliance) and Ben (your account lead) so we can respond with a single package.

High level: we capture a broad admin telemetry surface and support both on-demand exports and periodic snapshots. I attached a compact matrix that maps event classes to retention tiers and export formats. Quick summary while Marissa polishes details:

- Events captured: console sign-ins (SSO/auth provider assertion), API key lifecycle (create/rotate/revoke), role/permission changes, model deploy events, config rollbacks, scaling/autoscale policy changes, and operator actions from dedicated/private deployments.
- Retention: default 90 days hot, 1 year warm, up to 7 years archived (enterprise contract dependent). Custody manifest available for snapshot handoffs.
- Exports: CSV, JSONL, Parquet. We can provide signed manifests with chunk-level HMACs and SHA256 checksums.
- Redaction & slices: tenant-scoped exports available; PII fields can be masked by column or redacted from export if required by your DPO.

Marissa — can you add SOC 2 / SIG-specific notes (sampling approach, attestation language) and confirm timelines? Ben — can you propose a delivery ETA for GreenBridge?

Sofia Ivanova
Director, Customer Security
Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: admin-telemetry-matrix.csv (csv stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 08:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit evidence: admin telemetry + export options (SOC 2 scope)

Elena / team — adding a few SOC 2 and SIG-specific clarifications below:

1) Event taxonomy & sample rates
- All admin action types listed by Sofia are captured at 100% fidelity in the control plane (create/modify/delete). For high-volume operator telemetry (e.g., autoscale decisions) we maintain aggregated traces and full event lineage available on-demand for audits.

2) Sampling & attestation for SOC 2
- For auditor convenience we produce an attested snapshot: a timeboxed bundle (with manifest) containing 100% of admin events for the requested window where possible. If the window is very large we provide a stratified sample with provenance proof.

3) Export mechanics and manifest
- Export formats: JSONL (canonical), Parquet (analytics-ready), CSV (tabular). Each export bundle includes:
  - manifest.json (SHA256 checksum per file, HMAC using customer-specific key)
  - provenance.tsv (operation_id, actor_internal, actor_external if present, timestamp, request_id)
  - redact-report.txt (if any PII masking applied)

4) Retention & legal hold
- Standard retention: 90d hot / 365d warm / 7y cold. We support temporary legal-hold freezes on data aging for evidence retention; customer must open a request via Console with approval chain (we log the hold as an immutable operation).

5) Delivery options & timeline
- Options: SFTP push, secure HTTPS pull, or AWS S3 (prefixed, presigned URLs). Delivery is encrypted in transit and at rest. We can produce the first draft bundle within 48 business hours for windows <= 30 days; larger windows or immutability-attested packages may need 3–7 business days depending on size and jurisdictional redaction.

If GreenBridge wants we can run a quick sample export for a 7-day window this week so auditors can validate format. Ben — can you coordinate the export request and confirm greenbridge's preferred delivery method?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: export-playbook-draft.pdf (pdf stub)

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@greenbridgehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, audit-team@greenbridgehealth.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit evidence: admin telemetry + export options (SOC 2 scope)

Thanks — this is exactly what the auditors wanted. A few quick items:

- We prefer S3 delivery (GreenBridge-owned bucket) with presigned object lifecycle of 14 days. Can you provide the presignated upload instructions?
- Please run the 7-day sample export (2025-05-25 to 2025-05-31). Auditors will validate the manifest and the provenance.tsv pairing.
- We need confirmation that exports will not include user passwords or raw auth tokens (we assume masked).
- Timeline: if you can deliver the sample by EOD Friday 6/13 that would keep us on schedule.

If you want to use our internal intake form for presigned uploads I can share a signed intake link.

Elena
Security & Privacy Lead
GreenBridge Health
